title: Single Number
keyIdea: XOR all numbers. x ^ x = 0, x ^ 0 = x, and XOR is order-independent, so every pair cancels and the one number that appears once is left.

approaches.name: XOR everything
approaches.idea: Your code: ans ^= nums[i] for every i.
